column5:
My vision for the DAOry is to position it as a long-term pillar of the Aurory community, focused on strengthening the relationship between the project and its most committed users.

We are currently in a transition phase for the game and the ecosystem. In moments like this, the DAO should focus less on short-term visibility and more on reinforcing the core community that already believes in the project, especially Aurorian holders, active players, and long-term supporters.

I believe the DAOry should adopt a slightly less conservative and more redistributive approach toward its community. Events, tournaments, incentives, and community-driven initiatives are powerful tools to keep engagement high while the project evolves.

At the same time, we already have strong infrastructure available. The DAOry website, platforms like Amiko.gg, and other community tools make it possible to organize events and initiatives efficiently. Leveraging these resources more consistently can help transform the DAO into a real hub for community interaction.

Additionally, the DAOry should aim to become a reliable and authoritative reference point for everything related to Aurory. Whether it is information about the game, early insights into upcoming features, or data and analysis related to the project’s economy, the DAO should help the community stay informed and connected to the ecosystem.

Ultimately, my goal is for the DAOry to act as a bridge between the Aurory team and the community, maintaining alignment, supporting engagement, and ensuring that the most dedicated members of the ecosystem continue to feel involved in the project’s future.

column5:
My vision for the DAOry is to empower its community of holders while building sustainable revenue streams that support the DAO long term.

I want to grow the DAOry into one of the strongest DAOs within the Solana ecosystem by focusing on both innovation and community. The holders are not just observers, they are part of the DAO itself. By maintaining a community first mindset, we ensure that every voice has the opportunity to contribute to the direction and growth of the DAOry.

During this period of Aurory’s development while we wait for the soft launch, it is especially important to maintain strong community engagement. Having PvP-focused leadership within the DAOry can help create events, initiatives, and discussions that keep the community excited, active, and invested in the future of the game and the DAO.

I also want to help bring greater visibility to the DAOry through content and clips. By building a strong online presence, we can introduce the DAOry to people who may have heard of us but are not yet part of the community. Increasing this visibility can help attract new members and strengthen the DAO’s position within the ecosystem.

Ultimately, my goal is to build a DAO that reflects the same passion and ambition that exists within the Aurory community. If we bring that enthusiasm and work together to grow the ecosystem, the DAOry can become one of the most impactful and respected DAOs on Solana.

Aurory has always been something I’ve been deeply passionate about, and I want to bring that same energy and commitment into the DAOry to help drive its success moving forward.

Experience and qualification 

My experience for the role of Community Lead for the DAOry comes from my consistent involvement in the Aurory community since November 2023. During that time, I have become one of the most active members within the Discord and the wider PvP community.

I have participated in most, if not all, tournaments hosted by the DAOry, while also organising and hosting my own tournaments since joining the community. These events have been designed to include players of all skill levels, ranging from one star only tournaments for beginners to full 1-5 star competitive formats for more experienced players.

Through these tournaments I have distributed a large amount of AURY in prizes, as well as additional rewards through giveaways for both participants and viewers who watch the tournaments live on stream. My goal with these events has always been to keep the community active, competitive, and engaged.

Alongside tournaments, I have also co-hosted Aurory Talks on Beccss’s streams, where we spoke with members of the Aurory team and DAOry councillors. These conversations helped highlight the people behind the project and allowed the community to better understand the roles and contributions that make the ecosystem work.

By building and supporting a PvP-focused community, I have developed a strong understanding of what players want from the game. I understand how players like to test strategies, push their limits, and compete while still maintaining a fun and welcoming environment.

Outside of community events, I have also been a content creator for nearly five years. I currently have some of the most viewed Aurory-related content created by a community member in the English-speaking space. I am also highly active on X, where I regularly engage with the community and help keep conversations about Aurory active.

Several current holders have mentioned that they discovered Aurory through my videos and later became part of the ecosystem. As a former Aurory Ambassador, I understand the responsibility of representing the project and ensuring the community feels engaged while also presenting the world of Aurory in an appealing way to new audiences.

Through videos, clips, livestreams, and social media engagement across multiple platforms, I aim to continuously bring new attention to Aurory while also helping people understand how they can become involved with the DAOry.

Finally, having previously served within the DAOry as an advisor, I already understand the responsibilities and expectations placed on council members. This experience has given me insight into how the DAO operates and how its strengths can be used effectively to support the community and the broader Aurory ecosystem.

Goals and approach 

My approach to the DAOry will always start with a community first mindset. The strength of any DAO comes from the people who support it, and my goal is to ensure that holders feel heard, valued, and involved in the direction of the DAO. By maintaining open communication and encouraging community participation, we can continue to build a strong and united holder base.

Another important goal is to help identify and support new revenue streams for the DAOry. Building sustainable income opportunities will help ensure the long term growth and stability of the DAO. By exploring creative initiatives and partnerships within the ecosystem and the community, we can continue to strengthen the DAO’s ability to support community activities and future development.

Promotion and visibility are also key parts of my approach. Through content creation, clips, and consistent social media activity, I aim to help bring more attention to the DAOry and introduce it to potential new members who may not yet be familiar with the community. Increasing awareness of the DAOry will help grow the holder base and strengthen its presence within the wider Aurory and Solana ecosystems.

I also want to continue finding new ways to keep the holder community engaged and enthusiastic. This can include tournaments, community events, discussions, and interactive initiatives that give members more opportunities to participate. Maintaining excitement and activity within the community is especially important during quieter periods.

Finally, I want to bring the same enthusiasm and passion I have always shown for Aurory into the DAOry. By channeling that energy into community initiatives, content, and engagement, I believe we can help grow the DAOry into one of the strongest and most respected DAOs within the Aurory ecosystem.
